## 1. Goal

Make Build a friendly first screen: a short welcome, six plain-language example tiles, then the job table. Machine, random jobs and CSV sit under "More ways to add jobs".

## 2. Background

**Design authority:** `docs/design/APPLE_DESIGN.md` (added by K-43). Direction "soft sheets": flat solid colours, hairline borders, one whisper shadow, translucent top bar and dock (`backdrop-filter`, solid fallback under `prefers-reduced-transparency` and `prefers-contrast: more`), no gradients except the scroll-edge fade, no glows, neon, purple, emoji icons or monospace fonts. System sans-serif only; numbers use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

**Palette (final):** light canvas `#F2F3F1`, surface `#FFFFFF`, text `#1B1F1D`, muted `#5B625E`, border `#CFD3D0`, accent teal `#0B5E6B`, red `#B42318`, amber `#8A4B00`, green `#1D7A34`, chart gray `#8A918D`. Dark: canvas `#121513`, surface `#1B1F1D`, text `#ECEFED`, muted `#A3ABA6`, border `#343A37`, accent `#5FB6C4`, red `#F0877C`, amber `#E0A24A`, green `#6FCB87`, chart gray `#8A918D`. Chart gray is for chart marks and rules only, never text.

**Rules that do not change (CLAUDE.md rule 7, PRD §7 and §8):** classic scripts on `window.APRM`, no ES modules, no `fetch`, no framework, no build step; works from `file://` offline; `textContent` only for user, file, URL and engine text; loading, empty and error states on every view; colours as CSS variables with light and dark values; Chart.js only in Compare, pinned with SRI, with a table fallback. Nothing here touches `core/`, `wasm/` or PRD §5, and every number shown must equal the engine JSON.

**Tone:** short plain sentences, sentence case, talk to the user. Plain words first, technical term beside them ("Shortest job first (SJF)"). Engine sentences (why log, validation errors) are shown verbatim; the UI may add a plain lead-in but never rewrites them. "Show details" (K-43) reveals the full technical view: exact numbers, raw aged keys, heap order, log kinds.

## 3. Scope

**In scope:**

- Welcome line and six "Try an example" tiles with plain names and one-line hints (copy list in the plan)
- Job table restyled: tabular numbers, inline row errors beside the field, plain column labels with the technical name in brackets
- Machine, Make random jobs and Import or export under one disclosure that opens in one click; current machine values stay visible as a summary line
- Plain errors with a lead-in and the engine sentence verbatim; empty state "No jobs yet. Add one, or start with an example."
- Toasts for loaded example, generated jobs, export

**Out of scope:**

- Run and Compare pages
- Changing preset data or the engine

## 5. Specification

Every preset in `APRM.presetsData` appears as a tile; clicking loads it through `APRM.presets.load`. Tile text comes from copy.js keyed by preset name. CSV rules unchanged (1 MB, 5000 jobs, bad rows listed). Memory shown in MB in tables; prose uses GB only when the MB value is an exact multiple of 1024.

## 6. Step-by-step tasks

1. Write tests for tiles, empty state, error lead-ins, round trip first
2. Restyle Build using K-43 components
3. Wire disclosure and summary line
4. Check keyboard order and errors beside fields
5. Screenshots light and dark before and after

## 7. Tests to write

| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tiles | Six tiles load six presets into the store | Jobs and machine equal the preset data |
| build-empty | Empty table shows the invitation sentence | Text matches copy.js |
| build-errors | Bad field shows lead-in plus engine sentence beside the field | Message appears next to the right input |
| csv-roundtrip | Export then import gives the same jobs | Equal |
| disclosure | More ways to add jobs opens in one click and keeps summary visible | Pass |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] Six example tiles with plain names and hints
- [ ] Job table restyled; errors beside fields
- [ ] More ways to add jobs opens in one click; machine values stay visible
- [ ] All Build text comes from copy.js; no innerHTML
- [ ] node tests/web/*.mjs green; works from file://; screenshots in the PR

## 9. How to verify

`node tests/web/*.mjs`; open `web/index.html` from `file://`, click each tile, add a bad job, export and import a CSV.

## 10. Viva notes

Build only collects inputs. Examiner question: "Where is the job validated?" In the engine; the page shows its message beside the field.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Hiding the machine values
- Rewording engine sentences
- Tiles that do not match preset names after a preset change
